title: Machine learning-coupled combinatorial mutagenesis enables resource-efficient engineering of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editor activities.
summary: The primary study couples machine-learning-guided combinatorial mutagenesis with experimental screening and structural/wet-lab validation to engineer Cas9 variants with increased activity. This is a specific genome-editor engineering result, with the assays and cell contexts bounding the claim.
ai_technology: PMC full Methods/Results: candidate search reduced by about 95%, top-hit enrichment about 7.5×, followed by validation of N888R/A889Q KKH-SaCas9 and derived base editor in human cells. First publication date from PMC 2022-04-25.
